rule: security: Windows short path compares unequal
reasoning: same() and inside() compare path text only. A file path in 8.3 short form (C:/Users/RUNNER~1/...) and git's long worktree path differ, so inside() says the file is outside every slot and the write is allowed.
On Windows HOME is often unset, so '~/x' expands to 'undefined/x' and the guard checks the wrong path.
